basis: Inherited variation in fifth-toe phalangeal number affects the skeleton.
Carcinoma originates in the urinary bladder; muscularis propria invasion is absent.
Faciodigitogenital syndrome with defining skeletal and digital abnormalities; genital features have no axis. Other organ damage is not established as common.
Cowden mucocutaneous hamartomas include oral lesions; thyroid lesions affect roughly 50-70% in Cowden disease, with limited subtype data. Cancer predispositions alone are excluded.
Congenital cerebral CSF accumulation; strabismus and iris coloboma are annotated 30-79%. Optic atrophy and hearing loss are only 1-4%.
Sclerosing bone disorder predominantly affecting the cranial vault. Palatal tori are bony lesions; common hearing damage is not established.
Lysosomal storage; skeletal and cardiac disease 80-99%, neurologic decline 30-79%. Cap omits common airway, retinal, hearing and oral involvement.
Paget carcinoma involves perianal skin; intestinal involvement is not inherent to this concept.
Childhood malignancy of lymphoid cells; lymphoma also receives the infectious_immune mechanism axis. No extranodal organ is consistently affected across the group.
Tuftsin deficiency impairs phagocyte function and causes recurrent infections. The supplied splenic abnormality does not establish common structural or functional splenic damage.
FKTN-related limb-girdle muscular dystrophy; cardiomyopathy is defining in the description and ancestry. Common intrinsic neurologic damage is not established.
Herpesvirus infection directly inflames the stomach.
Inherited defective dental enamel mineralization; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Bacterial biofilm-mediated caries destroys dentine; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Peroxisomal metabolic disorder; neurologic impairment, cataract and nephrocalcinosis/neurogenic bladder each reported in 1/1 patient. Subtype evidence is sparse.
Premalignant epithelial dysplasia confined to the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Epilepsy syndromes defined by prominent myoclonic seizures; skeletal muscle jerks do not establish muscle disease.
Inherited retinal cone-rod degeneration causes visual loss and macular abnormalities.
Tear deficiency and ocular surface disease affect the lacrimal system, cornea and conjunctiva. Autoimmunity is not inherent to this umbrella concept.
Disease of the heart's electrical conduction system.
Choroidal neovascularization damages the retina and macula; local ocular vessels do not establish systemic cardiovascular disease.
Inherited erythrocyte membrane disorder. Jaundice reflects hemolysis rather than liver injury; renal tubular acidosis is only 5-29%.
Contractures and proprioceptive sensory neuropathy define disease. Respiratory insufficiency (6/6) is typically neonatal and transient, without established lasting lung damage.
Congenital thyroid synthesis defect; neurodevelopmental delay and epiphyseal abnormalities each annotated 30-79%. Hearing loss is only 1-4%.
Carcinoma originates in renal cells. Prior neuroblastoma defines the clinical setting and is a separate disease.
